newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Britain needs clarification from Turkey - Rifkind.
newsitem.headline: Britain needs clarification from Turkey - Rifkind.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said on Sunday that London was seeking details from Turkey about its intentions on the Iraqi border.

Speaking to reporters at an EU foreign ministers' meeting, Rifkind said he wanted to know whether Turkish moves on the border were designed to protect it from a sudden flow of refugees, or whether there was "some wider purpose".
"We are still seeking further clarification," he said.
On Saturday, Rifkind appeared to break from his European Union partners by saying that countries would understand if Turkey took action on the Iraqi border to protect itself from a refugee surge.

U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher had said much the same in London earlier in the day. The EU ministers, however, publicly stated that the territorial integrity of all countries in the region had to be protected.

Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller has vowed Turkey will create a shallow security zone inside northern Iraq to help fight Turkish Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) rebels who use the mountains there as a sanctuary for attacks against her country.
